duration.text: The Chinese program at China University of Petroleum (Huadong) is a 2 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1944 USD/per year ￥ 14000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included 2.Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant 3.Health certificate Photocopy of notarized foreigner physical examination record (for durations of study over 6 months)

requirements.text: 1.Applicants should be non-Chinese citizen with good health. 2."O-Level" Certificate and results, or a letter from your current school which shows that you have successfully completed two years of high school. 3. English test results: Applicants from non-English speaking countries are required to submit a TOEFL score of 68/190/520 or IELTS 5.0, or pass SCUT's placement test.
